summary: Original navigation decision patterns, not mandatory templates. Responsive transformation preserves route and destination semantics.

references.title: IBM Carbon Global header
references.lesson: Header-only or header-with-left-panel depending on hierarchy and persistent submenu needs
references.limit: Carbon patterns are for IBM shell; other sites may differ

references.title: IBM Carbon UI Shell left panel
references.lesson: Use side panel for many secondary items or frequent secondary switches; constrain deep nesting
references.limit: More than five secondary items is Carbon guidance, not a universal hard threshold

references.title: Android responsive navigation
references.lesson: Window width and destination count jointly drive bar rail or drawer
references.limit: Mobile native patterns are inspiration, not forced Web behavior

references.title: Android layout and navigation patterns
references.lesson: Bottom nav exposes roughly three to five top-level destinations, tabs are secondary views
references.limit: Actual web labels, device and IA still determine selection

references.title: Apple HIG Sidebars and Tab bars
references.lesson: Sidebar needs space; adaptable navigation can use compact tabs or expanded sidebar
references.limit: Apple platform guidance not prescriptive for browser products

references.title: Microsoft NavigationView display modes
references.lesson: Top for a few broad peer categories, left for more categories or hierarchy
references.limit: WinUI native component is used for design reasoning only

references.title: Atlassian navigation system layout
references.lesson: Top and side navigation areas should represent distinct scopes
references.limit: Not all Atlassian layout zones required in other products

references.title: W3C WAI Accessible navigation names
references.lesson: Multiple nav landmarks need differentiated accessible names
references.limit: Semantics alone does not prove full accessibility

patterns.name: 顶部主导航
patterns.why: 入口少且平级，主内容/摄影需要完整横向空间
patterns.tradeoff: 更多栏目和多层树不适合长期挤在顶部

patterns.name: 持久侧边导航
patterns.why: 反复切换的功能分区或持久目录适合纵向扫描
patterns.tradeoff: 占横向空间，不宜强制套手机或营销首页

patterns.name: 顶部全局 + 侧边局部
patterns.why: 全局工作区/账户与产品内任务导航是两个不同层级
patterns.tradeoff: 双层框架占空间；若重复同级链接需删一个

patterns.name: 窄轨道 + 对象列表/详情
patterns.why: 需要并排管理两级对象层级，保留主要内容
patterns.tradeoff: 无标签图标难懂，窄窗可能压缩三列

patterns.name: 手机底部主导航
patterns.why: 约三到五个同级高频入口，便于单手反复切换
patterns.tradeoff: 不宜容纳大量分区或当前上下文操作按钮

patterns.name: 桌面侧边 + 手机底部自适应
patterns.why: 宽屏显示完整导航，手机露出高频 3–5 项；完整入口从更多或抽屉可达
patterns.tradeoff: 需要稳定 ID、路由覆盖映射和状态保留；不可同时重复显示

patterns.name: 手机顶部上下文 + 底部主导航
patterns.why: 顶部解释当前页面和操作，底部负责全局切换，两个区域不重复
patterns.tradeoff: 屏幕垂直空间紧张时需控制 header 高度与键盘遮挡

patterns.name: 侧边导航 + 底部任务操作条
patterns.why: 侧栏负责目的地，底部负责当前对象的操作，两者不是双重主导航
patterns.tradeoff: 固定操作条会占垂直空间，需处理键盘和遮挡

patterns.name: 沉浸式/步骤式少导航
patterns.why: 当前任务需要专注，保留清晰返回与退出通路
patterns.tradeoff: 频繁跨任务切换不方便，应确保恢复上下文
